decision: Camila r3 (2026-11-01, 'for conjunctive is this only a problem on "lite" mode, if so make lite mode the same number of positions as default'): conjunctive_association lite reads ALL 19 positions of the summary request (the same positions as reads=full: the suffix 'Summarize the preceding story in one sentence.' plus the chat tail), at every full layer, as association does (Camila r2). For this family reads=lite therefore selects exactly the reads=full cells; a lite run differs from full only in its '+reads-lite' stamp. No new readouts: lite was always a subset of full, and the full cells are unchanged.
